description: Land Acquisition - Veddukadu, Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi  District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is only in his capacity to authorize the land acquisition process, and the core content focuses exclusively on land/property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
